Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.persistence.repository.paymentexecution

Interface KfeTransactionRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<KfeTransactionEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<KfeTransactionEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<KfeTransactionEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<KfeTransactionEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<KfeTransactionEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<KfeTransactionEntity>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<KfeTransactionEntity,UUID>
@Repository public interface KfeTransactionRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<KfeTransactionEntity,UUID>
Loads, locks, and scans persisted financial transactions for execution and user-facing history.

Owner-scoped methods restrict results to a transaction's user. Participant-visible methods additionally expose inbound internal transfers to the owner of the destination wallet. Pessimistic queries serialize settlement and state transitions, while background scans select confirmation and reorganization work in deterministic or oldest-first order.

  • Method Details

    • acquireInboundProviderReferenceLock

      @Query(value="SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(:providerReference))", nativeQuery=true) void acquireInboundProviderReferenceLock(@Param("providerReference") String providerReference)
      Serializes inbound settlement attempts sharing one provider reference.

      Acquire this transaction-scoped advisory lock before locking candidate transaction rows. Consistent ordering prevents replayed settlement checks from deadlocking while checking for duplicate external references across multiple rows.

      Parameters:
      providerReference - external reference used by the competing inbound settlement attempts

    • findParticipantVisibleById

      @Query("select t from KfeTransactionEntity t\nwhere t.id = :id\n and (\n t.userId = :userId\n or (\n t.rail = :internalRail\n and t.direction = :internalDirection\n and t.destinationWalletId in (\n select destinationWallet.id from KfeWalletEntity destinationWallet\n where destinationWallet.userId = :userId\n )\n )\n )\n") Optional<KfeTransactionEntity> findParticipantVisibleById(@Param("id") UUID id, @Param("userId") Long userId, @Param("internalRail") KfeRail internalRail, @Param("internalDirection") KfeDirection internalDirection)
      Resolves a transaction visible to its owner or to the recipient of an internal transfer.

      Recipient visibility applies only when both rail and direction match the supplied internal values and the destination wallet belongs to the requesting user.

      Parameters:
      id - transaction UUID
      userId - requesting user
      internalRail - enum value identifying internal transfers
      internalDirection - enum value identifying the inbound participant view
      Returns:
      transaction when the requester is a permitted participant
